newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: STIC invests S$13.8 mln in China projects.
newsitem.headline: STIC invests S$13.8 mln in China projects.

text.p: Singapore Technologies Industrial Corporation Ltd (STIC) said on Friday it was investing S$13.8 million in three leisure projects in China.
It said in a company statement that the investments in Zhengzhou, Xian and Pudong were part of plans to expand its leisure and lifestyle business in the region.
STIC plans to build a leisure park in Zhengzhou, a commercial and historical attraction with a cable car system near Xian and a gigantic walk-through aquarium in Pudong.

STIC, a diversified conglomerate with interests ranging from building infrastructure to food production, said its partners in the projects are Singapore's Straco Investment and China's stated-owned Poly Technologies.
STIC will hold an equity stake of 20 percent in each of the proejcts. -- Singapore Newsroom 65-8703080
